text: Completed the canonical image representation contract. PRD now records DEC-029, API-024, MIG-450, and AC-057 through AC-059; docs define logical (i,j,k[,t]) axes, third-grid-axis z versus affine world orientation, Ravel C-order and strided views, exact ScalaFIM first-axis-fastest formulas, ownership, slicing, typed failures, and explicit view-or-materialize ingress. Added randomized JVM/Scala.js differential tests, naive-transpose regression, strided-view and permuted-affine cases, plus a JVM matched workload court. Verified image4s-core 12 JVM and 12 JS tests, image4s-laws 5 JVM and 4 JS tests, PRD 148 IDs/27-node 86-edge DAG, build graph, and 516-symbol ownership. Direct ranked Ravel traversals allocate 40 B total; checked Sampled.valueAt visibly allocates 30.7-41.8 MB over 22,440 samples and costs 110.5-140.3 ns/sample, establishing the mandatory next-bead baseline.
